Olga — reviewed their redline. High-level guidance and proposed edits: 

1) BA vs DPA: we do not typically sign a separate BA contract; the DPA with a limited HIPAA clause is our standard approach. However, any language that expands liability or requires us to accept obligations beyond our control plane (e.g., direct indemnities tied to customers' HIPAA violations) is a no-go. I attached a countersigned draft (RDW_DPA_Counters_v2.docx) with inline comments.

2) Retention: accept 12 months as a one-off for MediStream, provided the customer agrees to a scoped exception and we add a monitoring clause that allows us to keep audit backups for a further 30 days to support incident response.

3) SCCs: include SCC Annex B as a standard addendum link; don't fold into the main DPA unless the customer explicitly requires contractual language for EU transfers.

4) Evidence: we can provide a redacted SOC 2 snapshot (no sensitive customer data) and a note on our HIPAA posture. See Redwood_SOC2_snapshot.pdf. That should satisfy procurement for the first pass. If they insist on a full audit report, we'll need an NDA/in-person exchange.

Signer routing: for the DPA as drafted (with our counters), Sales can run DocuSign after Legal approval. If MediStream insists on full BA-level obligations, escalate to CRO for signature approval.

Next steps: Olga, please push the RDW_DPA_Counters_v2.docx to Elena and call out the 12-month retention concession + the 30-day backup carveout. Ask whether they need exec-level signoff and confirm DocuSign routing.

—Marissa

Hi Elena — thanks for the redline. Attached is Redwood's counters with inline notes (RDW_DPA_Counters_v2.docx). Key points up front: 

- HIPAA: Redwood will not sign a standalone BA. We've proposed DPA language that maps to HIPAA obligations for processing ePHI and limits liability to our standard thresholds. We cannot accept broad indemnities tied to customer compliance failures.
- Retention: we will accept a 12-month retention period for PHI access logs as a one-time concession. We will include an emergency 30-day backup retention window for incident support.
- SCCs: we can append SCC Annex B as a separate addendum (if/when needed), rather than changing the body of the DPA.

Please confirm if MediStream can accept the counters above. If you need an executive approval route, please say so now — otherwise Sales can proceed with DocuSign after Legal signs off.
